newsHighlights.title: From robot competitions to inclusive cross-border AI cooperation
newsHighlights.summary: Robot contests are evolving into inclusive cross-border AI cooperation, with experts calling for shared standards, joint research and wider participation in the AI revolution.
newsHighlights.translation: 机器人竞赛正演变为包容性的跨境人工智能合作，专家呼吁建立共同标准、开展联合研究，让更多人参与人工智能革命。

newsHighlights.title: Xi: Building a community with a shared future in cyberspace
newsHighlights.summary: China called for global coordination to build a community with a shared future in cyberspace, stressing open, fair and safe digital governance.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国呼吁全球加强协调，共同构建网络空间命运共同体，强调开放、公平、安全的数字治理。

newsHighlights.title: Swap facility gives boost to A shares
newsHighlights.summary: China's central bank is preparing a fresh round of funding support for institutional investors to bolster capital market liquidity and stability.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国央行正准备新一轮资金支持，为机构投资者注入流动性，以增强资本市场的流动性与稳定性。

newsHighlights.title: US to host trilateral talks with Russia, Ukraine next week in UAE
newsHighlights.summary: The United States will host trilateral talks with Russia and Ukraine in the UAE next week, with a US envoy mediating the negotiations.
newsHighlights.translation: 美国将于下周在阿联酋主办与俄罗斯、乌克兰的三方会谈，由美国特使斡旋调解。

quote.quote: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
quote.author: Alan Kay
quote.translation: 预测未来最好的方式，就是去创造它。
quote.explanation: 这句话强调：未来并非被动等待的结果，而是由创新者主动塑造的。它呼应了今日新闻中从机器人竞赛走向跨境AI合作的主题——技术的未来取决于我们今天如何合作与创造。

pattern.pattern: From A to B（从……到……，表示从一种状态/阶段演变为另一种）
pattern.example: From robot competitions to inclusive cross-border AI cooperation, young engineers are now working on shared global challenges.
pattern.translation: 从机器人竞赛到包容性的跨境人工智能合作，年轻的工程师们正在共同应对全球性挑战。
pattern.usage: 常用于标题和段首，展示事物的发展历程或对比变化。A 和 B 结构应保持平行（均为名词短语）。例如：From surviving to thriving（从生存到繁荣）；From lab research to real-world application（从实验室研究到实际应用）。

grammar.title: with 复合结构（with + 宾语 + 宾补）
grammar.explanation: “with + 名词/代词 + 现在分词/过去分词/介词短语/形容词” 构成独立主格结构，在句中作状语，表伴随、原因或补充说明。若宾语与补语之间是主动关系，用现在分词（doing）；被动关系用过去分词（done）。这一结构在英语新闻中极为常见，能使句子更紧凑。
examples: The central bank is preparing a fresh round of funding support, with institutional investors preparing to increase their positions in A shares.
Experts called for cross-border AI cooperation, with shared data standards and open-source tools helping developing economies catch up.

pronunciation.tips: 注意重音在第四个音节 -ra- 上，前面的 co-o-pə 要弱读、快速带过。/əʊ/ 是双元音，口型从半开滑向收圆；结尾 -tion 读作 /ʃn/，不要读成 “提翁”。常见错误是把重音放在第二音节（co-OP-er-a-tion），这是不对的。
examples: Inclusive cross-border AI cooperation benefits every participating country.
International cooperation in science has accelerated in recent years.

reading.title: From Robot Competitions to Cross-Border AI Cooperation
reading.content: What began as robot competitions among students and engineers is now evolving into inclusive cross-border AI cooperation. At a recent forum, experts urged countries to build a community with a shared future in cyberspace, arguing that artificial intelligence should serve people everywhere rather than widen the digital divide. Speakers noted that joint research projects, shared data standards and open-source tools can help developing economies take part in the AI revolution. China has called for stronger coordination on AI governance, safety and talent training. Observers say robot contests remain valuable because they spark young people's interest in science, but the real prize is cooperation: when laboratories in different countries work together, breakthroughs in healthcare, education and climate modeling arrive faster. The message is clear — technology thrives when it is shared, and the future of AI depends on how well nations can invent it together.
reading.translation: 始于学生与工程师之间机器人竞赛的活动，如今正演变为包容性的跨境人工智能合作。在最近的一次论坛上，专家们呼吁各国共同构建网络空间命运共同体，认为人工智能应当服务于所有人，而不是扩大数字鸿沟。发言者指出，联合研究项目、共享数据标准和开源工具可以帮助发展中经济体参与人工智能革命。中国呼吁在人工智能治理、安全和人才培养方面加强协调。观察人士认为，机器人竞赛依然有价值，因为它们激发了年轻人对科学的兴趣；但真正的收获在于合作——当不同国家的实验室携手工作时，医疗、教育和气候建模领域的突破会来得更快。道理很清楚：技术因分享而繁荣，而人工智能的未来取决于各国能如何共同创造它。
reading.sourceNote: 基于 CGTN 新闻 “From robot competitions to inclusive cross-border AI cooperation” 与 ChinaDaily 新闻 “Xi: Building a community with a shared future in cyberspace” 改写。
